stories.title: Burnham hails approval for two huge windfarm projects as ‘power under British control’ – UK politics live
summary: (See 9.56am.)This is from Natasha Curry, deputy director of research at the Nuffield Trust and one of the report’s authors.Compared to the other countries we looked at, the governance of England’s social care system is confused and complex.
The serious consequences of this were laid bare during the Covid pandemic.The system for governing adult social care in England has evolved haphazardly and with little clear planning.

That has scattered responsibility for the sector across and outside government in a way that few would design from scratch.This report makes for sober reading of how adult social care and those who rely on it have been systematically failed.
